# `webmcp/consequential-abort-signal`

**ESLint-only rule** · `suggestion` · in `recommended`

A tool that declares consequentialHint and waits in its execute should read the abort signal it is given; a canceled call keeps running otherwise, and its side effect happens after the agent was told it did not.

This rule has no counterpart in the `@swissspidy/webmcp-lint` engine: it reads the source, and what it catches does not survive to runtime for a page rule to see.

## Configuring it

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/consequential-abort-signal": "warn" } }
```
